question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks and make the sentence meaningful.

I taught my son the ________ way to tie a _________.
solution:
The correct answer is "**right; knot**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** In the given sentence, the first blank will indicate the correct way that has been taught to the subject's son.**
 
• **Thus, among the given options, the correct word to use in blank 1 is "right**.
 
 
• Therefore, options, 2 and 4 are eliminated.
 
 
 
• "Right" means correct or proper.(सही)
 
 
• Example: You should learn the right way to behave.
 
 
 
• **The second blank will imply tying something, in this case it is a "knot.**"
 
 
• Therefore, option 1 will also be eliminated.(गाँठ)
 
 
 
• "Knot" refers to a tangle or loop in a piece of rope or string.
 
 
• Example: I find it difficult to tie a knot.
 
 

Hence,** the correct answer is option 3**.
